title: Grand Theft Auto VI
summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is a single-player game set in the state of Leonida, focused on protagonists Lucia and Jason and launching in November 2026.
bodyMarkdown:
## Overview

"Grand Theft Auto VI is a single-player experience".{{cite:playstation-store-ultimate}} Rockstar markets the game under the tagline Only in Leonida and highlights Vice City, USA.{{cite:gta6-official-site}}

## Release and platforms

Rockstar’s pre-load announcement shows the game as coming November 19, 2026.{{cite:gta6-pre-load-page}} The physical version contains a download code and will not include a disc.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}}

## Editions and pricing

Grand Theft Auto VI is available in Standard and Ultimate Editions.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}} The Standard Edition includes the game and allows later purchase of the Ultimate Edition Upgrade.{{cite:gta6-support-platforms}} Take-Two lists the Standard Edition price as $79.99.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}} Take-Two lists the Ultimate Edition price as $99.99.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}} The Ultimate Edition is described as "an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel, and action threaded across" Jason and Lucia’s story.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}} Digital pre-orders and purchases prior to November 20, 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack and one month of GTA+.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}}

## Setting and protagonists

The story is set in Vice City, within the wider state of Leonida.{{cite:taketwo-preorders}} Lucia Caminos was taught to fight by her father.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Lucia’s fights "for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary", from which luck freed her.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Jason Duval grew up around grifters and crooks.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Jason served a stint in the Army after troubled teens.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Jason worked for local drug runners in the Keys before meeting Lucia.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

## PlayStation 5

Grand Theft Auto VI is available on PS5 and labeled PS5 Pro Enhanced.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} The PS5 version supports DualSense haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and the controller's integrated speaker.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} The game leverages the PS5 ultra-high speed SSD for near-instant load times.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} Digital pre-orders include a one-month GTA+ subscription claimable before March 31, per the PS Store listing.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} Pre-loading on PS5 began November 10 according to PlayStation's pre-load guide.{{cite:playstation-gta6}} Downloaded content can be played on the main PS5 console tied to an account and other PS5 consoles when signing in with the same account.{{cite:playstation-gta6}}

## Xbox consoles and cloud streaming

Xbox Wire says cloud-streamed sessions use Xbox Series S graphics settings.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}} Xbox Series X supports native play and pre-installation per Xbox Wire.{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}} Xbox Series S is described as "the most affordable way to play GTA VI natively on Xbox".{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}} Streaming "availability, purchasing options, supported devices, account eligibility, and features may vary by market and device".{{cite:xbox-cloud-gta6}}

title: Story
summary: What official sources have said about Grand Theft Auto VI's premise, its two central characters, and its setting in Leonida.
bodyMarkdown:
## Official premise

Rockstar's official site states: "Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them."{{cite:gta6-official-site}} The same passage says that "when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive."{{cite:gta6-official-site}}

## Protagonists

The story is presented around two central characters, Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, whose official biographies appear on Rockstar's Only in Leonida pages.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}}{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Rockstar describes Lucia as "Fresh out of prison and ready to change the odds in her favor."{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Official copy introduces Jason with the line "Jason wants an easy life, but things just keep getting harder."{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

## Setting

The official site places that premise in "Vice City, USA," which it calls "The darkest side of the sunniest place in America."{{cite:gta6-official-site}} Rockstar's Only in Leonida page calls Leonida "Home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond."{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}}

summary: The characters Rockstar has introduced with official biographies for Grand Theft Auto VI, led by protagonists Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval.
bodyMarkdown:
## Overview

Rockstar's official biographies for Grand Theft Auto VI center on two protagonists, Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, and a group of associates named on the Only in Leonida pages.{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}} The official site frames their story around "an easy score" that "goes wrong" and a "criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida."{{cite:gta6-official-site}}

## Protagonists

Rockstar introduces Lucia Caminos as a Vice City character whose father "taught her to fight as soon as she could walk," and whose official biography mentions a term at Leonida Penitentiary.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Official materials introduce Jason Duval as someone who "grew up around grifters and crooks," later "working for local drug runners" in the Keys.{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Jason's page says "Meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing to ever happen to him."{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

## Associates named in official biographies

Rockstar also publishes official write-ups for Cal Hampton, described as "Jason’s friend and a fellow associate of Brian’s"; Boobie Ike, "a local Vice City legend"; Dre'Quan Priest, who "signed the Real Dimez"; Real Dimez, the duo Bae-Luxe and Roxy; Raul Bautista, "a seasoned bank robber"; and Brian Heder, "a classic drug runner from the golden age of smuggling in the Keys."{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}} Those pages are the basis for the individual character articles in this section.

Rockstar introduces Jason Duval with the line "Jason wants an easy life, but things just keep getting harder."{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Official biography says he "grew up around grifters and crooks."{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

## Army service and the Keys

Rockstar writes that after "a stint in the Army trying to shake off his troubled teens," Jason "found himself in the Keys doing what he knows best, working for local drug runners."{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} The official page adds, "It might be time to try something new."{{cite:gta6-people-jason}}

Official materials say "Meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing to ever happen to him."{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Rockstar adds that Jason "knows how he'd like it to turn out but right now, it's hard to tell."{{cite:gta6-people-jason}} Lucia's page says "A life with Jason could be her way out."{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}}

## Overview

Rockstar presents Leonida as the state in which Grand Theft Auto VI is set.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} Official site copy welcomes players to "Leonida, the state where anything goes."{{cite:gta6-official-site}} The official premise places "a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida."{{cite:gta6-official-site}} Only in Leonida pages call the state "Home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond."{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}}

## Destinations named by Rockstar

The official Only in Leonida page invites players to "Tour a few of the must-see destinations across the sunshine state."{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}} The destinations it names are Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga.{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}} Lucia's official biography also names Leonida Penitentiary.{{cite:gta6-people-lucia}} Official pages do not, in the sources cited here, publish a complete map of every place in the state, so this article stays with the names Rockstar has listed.{{cite:gta6-only-in-leonida}}

## Role in the official premise

The official site locates Jason and Lucia's story on "the darkest side of the sunniest place in America" and in a conspiracy that spans Leonida.{{cite:gta6-official-site}} Rockstar describes Vice City, inside that state, as "Vice City, USA."{{cite:gta6-official-site}}
